subject: art-design

moments.title: Sunday on La Grande Jatte
moments.body: Seurat paints over two years using small dots of pure colour mixed in the viewer's eye, drawing on Chevreul's colour theory.
moments.takeaway: Late 19th-century painting was in dialogue with optical science.

moments.title: Last Impressionist show
moments.body: La Grande Jatte is exhibited at the eighth Impressionist exhibition. The label 'neo-impressionism' is coined.
moments.takeaway: New movements branched off public exhibitions.

moments.title: Seurat dies
moments.body: Seurat dies aged 31 of probable meningitis, leaving a small but influential body of work.
moments.takeaway: Short careers can still redirect a tradition.

now.title: Pointillism now
now.body: Pixels and halftone dots in modern reproduction echo Seurat's logic. Sondheim's musical Sunday in the Park with George (1984) brought the painting to a new audience.
now.open_questions: What other 19th-century optical experiments anticipated digital images?

reflection: A painter who explained colour theory could not stop colour from changing on him.
